messages:
noah: Starting a short bring-up for cust-pegasus LoRA merge onto oak-13b-v3. Their tokenizer adds <CUR> and <VAT> and swaps decimal/grouping locale (comma vs dot). Quick-eval flagged token splits + int3 regression.
maya: Quick bullet summary?
noah: (1) Tokenizer inserts 2 specials and shifts ~6 high ids. (2) Locale differences cause numbers like 1.234,56 to be tokenized differently. (3) Tested int3 quant (experimental) + int4; int3 shows larger EM drop than expected.
harry: Any runtime failures when testing long contexts?
liz: Saw a kv_cache mismatch during multi-request streaming: ``RuntimeError: kv_cache length mismatch expected=24 got=20 at runtime/kv_cache.cpp:150``. Root cause: model.config.max_position_embeddings left at 4096 while customer uses 7k contexts. Bumped to 8192 for tests and streaming stabilized.
maya: What do the quick-eval numbers look like? short numbers please.
noah: Invoice/amount extraction quickpack:
- oak-13b-v3 fp16 baseline: EM=0.84 F1=0.91
- merged pegasus-lora fp16: EM=0.82 F1=0.90
- merged pegasus-lora int4 (per-channel asym): EM=0.78 F1=0.87
- merged pegasus-lora int3 (experimental): EM=0.71 F1=0.83
Int3 quant has a big hit; int4 is salvageable with fixes.
harry: Can you paste a couple minimal failing examples?
noah: Example 1:
input: "Total \u20ac: 1.234,56"
baseline: "Total \u20ac: 1.234,56"
merged-int4: "Total \u20ac 1 234,56"
merged-int3: "Total euro one thousand two hundred thirty four point fifty six"
Example 2:
input: "VAT 21% on 45,00"
baseline: "VAT: 21% on 45,00"
merged-int4: "VAT 21 percent on 45,00"
merged-int3: "VAT 21 45 00"
So int3 collapses punctuation and locale tokens into words or splits numbers.
maya: Run token diff and attach minimal mapping snippet.
noah: token_diff snippet: ``\u20ac => base:[3320] candidate:[302,7091]; "," => base:[45] candidate:[45]; "." => base:[12] candidate:[12]; '1.234,56' => base:[1002,12,234,45,56] candidate:[1002,4008,7091,56]``
So currency symbol broken into two ids and the decimal/grouping tokens remapped causing number splits. Occurs ~0.5% of quickpack samples.
harry: Quant sims? did we run per-channel vs per-tensor, bias-correction, QAT?
noah: Ran quick sims: per-channel asymmetric int4 EM delta -0.04; per-tensor symmetric int4 EM delta -0.09. int3 (experimental) per-channel asymmetric EM delta -0.13. Ran a 600-step QAT sim on LoRA params only: projected EM loss -0.02. Artifacts uploaded.
eval-bot: quant_sim artifacts: /artifacts/pegasus/1789991111/quant_sim.json. QAT sim: /artifacts/pegasus/1789991111/qat_sim.json
maya: Quick remediation ideas? list short.
harry: 1) Reindex LoRA embeddings to base tokenizer ids (accurate but heavier). 2) Add preprocess normalization that collapses known split sequences (fast) and normalize locale number formatting during parsing. 3) Prefer fp16 canary rollout and hold int3/int4 until QAT or remerge recovers EM. 4) Add token-diff preflight rule: any base token that maps to >1 tokens in candidate for >0.1% samples flags merge.
liz: I pushed a tiny preprocess that normalizes currency tokens and collapses common split pairs (e.g., [302,7091] -> \u20ac) and normalizes locale numbers to a canonical form for evaluation. Reran int4 quickpack: EM improved 0.78 -> 0.80. Still below fp16 but closer.
maya: Rollout suggestion?
harry: Start fp16 canary (5%) on dedicated pool; block int3/int4 until either QAT or remerge gets EM within 0.03 of baseline. Set fallback rule: EM_drop >= 0.035 -> revert.
noah: Filed GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/customer-onboards/issues/4412 with token dumps, failing samples, token_diff and suggested fixes.
deploy-bot: Canary requested: pegasus-lora-fp16 -> dedicated/pool-4 (5%). Fallback policy: EM_drop>=0.035 sliding window 1k requests.
eval-bot: Added quick-eval token-drift check. If a base symbol token maps to >1 tokens in candidate for >0.1% of samples, CI flags as token-drift.
liz: Action items: (1) noah: extend preprocess to more locale cases and produce final artifacts, (2) harry: try token-aligned remerge and a longer QAT run, (3) maya: enable canary + dashboards, (4) eval-bot: add token-diff alert to quickpack.
harry: We'll pause int3 experiments for production until we have a QAT path that projects <0.03 EM loss. Reopen when quant/QAT artifacts uploaded. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
